name: site_info

It returns the site name, domain, locale, market (and country, when known) and home URL; where the site has them, its social channels and a contact e-mail address. Do not use to look for travel content (use search_site) or to sign up for the newsletter (use subscribe_newsletter).

name: calculate_pass_prices
title: Compare attraction pass prices
description: Use this when the traveller is choosing between buying New York attraction tickets separately and buying an attraction pass, and wants to know which costs less for their group. It compares the total price of the selected attractions bought separately with the cheapest and the recommended attraction pass. When no pass saves money, the result has `advice`, `nearestPass` (the closest pass, with `extraCost` = how much more than buying separately), `passPicker` and `attractionLinks` (own page or Viator link per attraction). Where available, a pass carries `url`, our own page for it, in place of a partner booking link. Every figure in the result is in USD, named once by the response's `currency` field, regardless of which site is asked. Do not use for browsing the attractions (call list_pass_picker_attractions first to get the ids) or for airport transfers (use calculate_transfer).

attractions.description: Attraction IDs from list_pass_picker_attractions, 1-50 items (duplicates are ignored).

days.description: Number of days (max 365), only for passes sold by day count.

grades.description: Optional map of attraction id -> grade id, for attractions that offer sub-attraction grades - see the "grades" field on each list_pass_picker_attractions result.

country.description: Optional. Answer from another country's own site, in its own language, currency and links. Accepted: GB = www.newyork.co.uk (en_GB), NL = www.newyork.nl (nl_NL), DE = www.newyorkcity.de (de_DE), FR = www.newyorkcity.fr (fr_FR), BR = www.visitenovayork.com.br (pt_BR), FI = www.newyork.fi (fi_FI), SE = www.newyork.se (sv_SE), IT = www.newyorkcity.it (it_IT), JP = www.newyork.jp (ja_JP), ES = www.nuevayork.es (es_ES), LATAM = www.nuevayork.com (es_419), CA = www.newyorkcity.ca (en_CA), AU = www.newyork.com.au (en_AU), NO = www.newyork.no (nb_NO), KR = www.newyork.kr (ko_KR), DK = www.newyorkcity.dk (da_DK). name: calculate_transfer
title: Price an airport transfer
description: Use this when the traveller asks what it costs to get between a New York airport (or another departure point) and their destination, and wants to compare taxi, shared shuttle, train and other options for their group size. It prices every available transfer option between a departure point and destination for a given group size. Every mode's `amount`/`currency` are the correct figures (basis: total for the whole group, not per person) - the flat `price` string is deprecated, kept for one release. Where available, an option carries `url`, our own page for it, which comes in place of a partner booking link. A mode with `unavailable: true` (in `modes`, or the whole entry in `skipped`) means no price is available for that mode right now. With `reverse` true the trip runs from a destination to an airport: `departure` is then a destination id and `destination` a departure id, both from list_transfer_options, and the planner link opens in reverse. Do not use for OMNY or subway-payment questions (use get_omny_card_info) or for nearby subway stops (use nearest_subway), and take the departure and destination ids from list_transfer_options.

reverse.description: True for a trip from a destination to an airport: departure is then a destination id and destination a departure id (default false).

These are shared, editorially-written plans, not a personal saved-trips list: this site has no visitor accounts or per-visitor trip storage. name: list_broadway_shows
title: Find Broadway shows on sale
description: Use this when the traveller asks about which Broadway shows they can see in New York, or on a given date, or about finding one by name. It lists the Broadway shows currently on sale on this site, with their show id, title, link to our own page (`url`), our own `image` where available, venue, synopsis, running time, rating code and venue address. priceFrom is in this site's own checkout currency, named by the sibling `currency` field. Without a date it is the show's lowest price over all dates; with `date` (or `from` and `to`, at most 7 days) only shows with a bookable performance then are listed, cheapest first, and priceFrom is the price in that window, equal to its lowestPrice, with lowestPriceDate. For the performance times of one show, pass its show id to get_performance_availability. Do not use for concerts, sports or nightlife (use list_events).

to.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD end of the window; use with `from`.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (default 0). The nextOffset of the previous result gives the next value.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback
description: Use this when a lookup here missed what the traveller was looking for or returned something wrong, or when they want to say what worked well. Stores one short note about this site: what was looked for, whether it was found, and what was missing, wrong or worked well. Personal details such as names, e-mail addresses and phone numbers are removed from the note before it is saved. It takes no questions, looks nothing up and signs nobody up for the newsletter.

looking_for.description: What was being looked for or done (1-200 characters).

note.description: What was missing, wrong or could be better, or what worked well (1-500 characters). Personal details are removed before it is saved.

page_or_tool.description: The page URL or tool name this is about (up to 200 characters).

name: subscribe_newsletter
title: Subscribe to the newsletter
description: Use this when the visitor asks to be signed up to this New York site's newsletter. It sends one e-mail address, which the visitor gave themselves, to this site's newsletter provider (Mailchimp), which then e-mails that address a confirmation link. The sign-up counts once the link is clicked.

email.description: The e-mail address the visitor wants the newsletter sent to (up to 254 characters).

name: nearest_subway
title: Find the nearest subway stop
description: Use this when the traveller asks which subway stops are closest to a New York place, or to a spot given as latitude/longitude, and how far the walk is. It finds the three nearest subway stops (with lines, distance in metres, an estimated walking time and whether the stop is step-free) to one of our places, by name, or to a latitude/longitude in New York, with a link to our own subway guide where we have one. It does not geocode street addresses: pass a place name we know or coordinates. Walking times are estimates from straight-line distance, and if both place and coordinates are given, place wins. Do not use to find the places themselves (use search_places) or to ask about the OMNY fare card (use get_omny_card_info).

latitude.description: Latitude in New York (40.4 to 41). Use with longitude instead of place.

longitude.description: Longitude in New York (-74.3 to -73.6). Use with latitude instead of place.

Each card has a short description, address, coordinates, Eric's tip, our own page `url` and `image` where available, where we sell a ticket (a link, no price), and the two nearest subway stops with walking-time estimates. At least one of query, category or near is required, and it does not geocode street addresses. Each card's url, image and ticket link are our own or carry our partner id. Do not use for events on a date (use list_events), Broadway shows (use list_broadway_shows) or hotels (use search_stayed_hotels).

name: new_york_weather
title: Check the New York forecast
description: Use this when the traveller asks what the weather will be like in New York on their dates, whether to expect rain, or what to do if it rains. It returns the US National Weather Service forecast for New York City: day and night periods for up to 7 days with temperature in Fahrenheit and Celsius, a short description and the chance of rain. Pass a date (YYYY-MM-DD) for one day; when rain is likely the answer adds a rain plan from our own guides. Pass rain_plan=true to get the rain plan whatever the forecast: our rain guide with its picture and up to 4 indoor places as cards. Forecast text is in English, as the National Weather Service wrote it. A result's url, image and ticket link are our own or carry our partner id. Do not use for dates beyond the 7-day forecast or for places outside New York City.

date.description: Optional day to return, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit it for the whole forecast.
